violations.text: Menu is lacking an allergen statement. New Violation. Correct By: 09/29/2026
The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. Inspector provided RIDOH guidance. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2026

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was 0 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200 ppm. PIC add more sanitizer. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2026

The door to the outside (located in the dining area) and the hallway door (in kitchen) are not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2025

The ice scoop at the bar was observed with handle in direct contact with ice. The ice scoop for the ice machine was stored on top of the ice machine. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2026

The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quaternary ammonium sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sinks. Inspector observed all test strips expired. Inspector provided during inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 09/15/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine and bar floor fan have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 09/29/2026
The threshold of the kitchen exit was observed in poor repair, with the concrete chipped and pieces missing. New Violation. Correct By: 09/29/2026

The doors to the outside, located in the front entrances, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. PIC has door sweeps on site to install. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2025
The automatic dispenser for the 3-bay sink sanitizer was not pulling sanitizer. Establishment has chlorine and test strips for use. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2025
